mapper.select: SELECT T1.PGM_NO AS pgmNo , T1.PGM_ID AS pgmId , T1.PGM_NM AS pgmNm , T1.PGM_GO AS pgmGo , T1.PARENT_PGM AS parentPgm , T1.PGM_KIND_CODE AS pgmKindCode , T1.SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder , T1.UPD_ID AS updId FROM FW_PGM_MST T1 , FW_ROLE_PGM T2 , FW_ROLE_MEMB T3 , FW_USER_MST T4 WHERE T1.PGM_NO = T2.PGM_NO AND T2.ROLE_NO = T3.ROLE_NO AND T3.MEMB_CODE1 = T4.CORP_GR AND T4.USER_ID = #{userId} AND T4.USER_NM = #{userNm} AND T1.PGM_KIND_CODE = 'M' AND T1.PARENT_PGM = '00000' AND T1.MENU_USE_YN = 'Y' AND T1.PGM_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORDER

SELECT t1.PGM_NO AS pgmNo , t1.PGM_NM AS pgmNm , t1.PGM_ID AS pgmId , t1.PGM_GO AS pgmGo , t1.PARENT_PGM AS parentPgm , t1.PGM_KIND_CODE AS pgmKindCode , t1.SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder , t1.TREE_LEVEL AS treeLevel , t1.TREE_LINE AS treeLine , t1.FULLPGM AS fullpgm , t1.FULLPGM1 AS fullpgm1 , t1.FULLPGM2 AS fullpgm2 FROM FW_PGM_MST t1 , ( select t2.PGM_NO from FW_ROLE_PGM T2 , FW_ROLE_MEMB T3 , FW_USER_MST T4 WHERE T2.ROLE_NO = T3.ROLE_NO AND T3.MEMB_CODE1 = T4.CORP_GR AND T4.USER_ID = #{userId} AND T4.USER_NM = #{userNm} ) t2 WHERE t1.PGM_NO = t2.PGM_NO and t1.PGM_KIND_CODE IN ('M', 'P') AND t1.MENU_USE_YN = 'Y' AND t1.PGM_USE_YN = 'Y' AND t1.PARENT_PGM != '00000' START WITH t1.PGM_NO = #{pgmNo} CONNECT BY PRIOR t1.PGM_NO = t1.PARENT_PGM ORDER SIBLINGS BY NVL(t1.SORT_ORDER, 0)

SELECT PGM_NO AS pgmNo , PGM_ID AS pgmId , PGM_NM AS pgmNm , PGM_GO AS pgmGo , FULLPGM AS fullpgm , FULLPGM1 AS fullpgm1 , FULLPGM2 AS fullpgm2 FROM FW_PGM_MST WHERE UPPER(PGM_ID) = UPPER(#{pgmId}) AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT T1.PGM_NO AS pgmNo , T1.PGM_ID AS pgmId , T1.PGM_NM AS pgmNm , T1.PGM_GO AS pgmGo , T1.PARENT_PGM AS parentPgm , T1.PGM_KIND_CODE AS pgmKindCode , T1.SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder , T1.FULLPGM AS fullpgm , T1.FULLPGM1 AS fullpgm1 , T1.FULLPGM2 AS fullpgm2 FROM FW_PGM_MST t1 , FW_ROLE_PGM T2 , FW_ROLE_MEMB T3 , FW_USER_MST T4 WHERE T1.PGM_NO = T2.PGM_NO AND T2.ROLE_NO = T3.ROLE_NO AND T3.MEMB_CODE1 = T4.CORP_GR AND T4.USER_ID = #{userId} AND T4.USER_NM = #{userNm} AND T1.PGM_KIND_CODE = 'P' AND T1.MENU_USE_YN = 'Y' AND T1.PGM_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY NVL(T1.SORT_ORDER, 0), T1.PGM_GO
